fields.why: Table 2 and the text compare 2017 prevalence across four age groups ('generally decreased with increasing age'), an outcome measured per SPD group.
Age is the only SPD with 3+ groups compared; race/ethnicity and sex enter only as model covariates, and states/regions are geography, not an SPD.

Age-group percentages and medians are set side by side with no test across ages. The chi-square tests compare 2011 with 2017 within each state, a non-SPD contrast, so the mechanical flag is a false hit.
